vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability is a division by zero in the takeFeeInProportions function. When totalFeeBuy or totalFeeSell is zero, the calculation proportionFeeAmount.mul(reflectionFeeBuy).div(totalFeeBuy) will cause a division by zero. The owner can set fees to zero via changeFees(), and any subsequent transfer that triggers fee calculation will revert.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the owner, set buy fees to zero via changeFees(), enable trading, then attempt a transfer that will calculate fees (buy from pair). This should trigger the division by zero.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Impersonate the contract owner using vm.prank. 2. Call changeFees() to set all buy fees to zero. 3. Enable trading via enableTrading(). 4. Attempt a transfer from the pair (simulating a buy) that will trigger takeFeeInProportions with totalFeeBuy = 0. 5. Expect the transaction to revert with division by zero.
